name: Hai yu Yu - Ocean and Fish
source:
Hanhai wakes up in an unfamiliar room, for reasons unknown, her calf cut by some sharp object. As she investigates her surroundings, she finds a male corpse in the bathroom and a mysterious room with an evil magic circle drawn on the floor... What exactly happened here?

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583800/]Steam[/url]]
